tools.name: rush_modules
tools.description: List available and unavailable Rush Analytics API modules. No API call, no balance spent. Works without RUSH_ANALYTICS_API_KEY. Only the 8 modules in `available` have working /create endpoints on apiv2. Modules in `unavailable` return "Unknown API function" — do not create tasks for them. Create typed tasks with rush_top10/rush_wordstat/rush_suggest/rush_fpp/rush_ranktracker; use rush_create_task for indexation/adwords/ai-results-tracker. Service tools: rush_balance (check balance), rush_status (task status by type+id), rush_projectids (list project ids by type, free), rush_update_ranktracker (force-refresh ranktracker project, may charge balance), rush_gds (Looker Studio aggregated views for ranktracker, read-only).

tools.name: rush_balance
tools.description: Get the remaining Rush Analytics balance (fractional number of available units). Free / no balance spent.

tools.name: rush_status
tools.description: Get the status of a task by type+id. GET /status/{type}/{id}. Returns {id, status, resulturl}. status values: "Parsing", "Done" (capitalized). Useful for recurring modules (ranktracker, ai-results-tracker) where rush_wait_result is not practical. Module type numbers: fpp=1, top10=2, ranktracker=3, wordstat=4, indexation=5, suggest=7, adwords=15, ai-results-tracker=32. No balance spent.

type.description: Numeric module type: fpp=1, top10=2, ranktracker=3, wordstat=4, indexation=5, suggest=7, adwords=15, ai-results-tracker=32

tools.name: rush_create_task
tools.description: Create a task in any available Rush Analytics module (generic, full API coverage). POST /create/{module}. Returns {id, type}; poll results with rush_get_result or rush_wait_result. Available modules (8): top10 (SERP), wordstat (search volume), suggest (suggestions), ranktracker (recurring rank monitoring), fpp (Fast Positions one-shot), indexation, adwords, ai-results-tracker. `params` is passed verbatim into the request body alongside the api key. Example for indexation: params={name, urls:["https://example.com"], searchEngines:["Yandex"]}. Example for ai-results-tracker: params={name, brandName, country:".ru", language:"ru", aiModels:["gpt"], dataCollectionFrequency:{frequency:1}, prompts:["..."], apikey omitted — added automatically}. Unavailable slugs (clustering, textanalyzer, whois, …) will return "Unknown API function".

module.description: Rush Analytics module slug. Available: top10, wordstat, suggest, ranktracker, fpp, indexation, adwords, ai-results-tracker. Unavailable slugs (clustering, textanalyzer, whois, …) return "Unknown API function".

params.description: Module-specific fields passed verbatim as request body (without apikey — added automatically). See rush_modules for slugs and Rush Analytics docs for each module's schema.

tools.name: rush_get_result
tools.description: Get a task result (single poll). While unfinished Rush returns "Project is not in done status" — `pending` flag is set. Standard modules (top10, wordstat, suggest, fpp, adwords, indexation): GET /result/{module}/{id}. Ranktracker: GET /result/ranktracker/{view}/{id}/{page}.   Valid views (11): dynamic | visibility | positions_history | urls_history | snippets_history |   competitors | competitors_visibility | competitors_leaders | competitors_positions | regions | compare_regions.   Default view: dynamic, default page: 1.   IMPORTANT: view="competitors_positions" requires `competitor` (competitor domain) — API returns 400 without it. AI-results-tracker: use view to select endpoint —   brand (default) → /result/ai-results-tracker/brand/{id} |   sources → /result/ai-results-tracker/sources/{id} |   competitors_brands → /result/ai-results-tracker/competitors/brands/{id} |   competitors_domains → /result/ai-results-tracker/competitors/domains/{id}. Optional periodStart/periodEnd (YYYY-MM-DD) filter date range for ranktracker and ai-results-tracker. Optional competitor (domain string) — REQUIRED for ranktracker view="competitors_positions"; ignored for all other views.

module.description: Rush Analytics module slug. Available: top10, wordstat, suggest, ranktracker, fpp, indexation, adwords, ai-results-tracker. Unavailable slugs (clustering, textanalyzer, whois, …) return "Unknown API function".

view.description: For ranktracker: view name (e.g. "dynamic"). For ai-results-tracker: brand|sources|competitors_brands|competitors_domains.

competitor.description: Competitor domain (e.g. "competitor.ru"). REQUIRED for ranktracker view="competitors_positions" — API returns 400 without it. Ignored for all other views.

tools.name: rush_wait_result
tools.description: Poll a task until it finishes or the timeout elapses. Convenience wrapper around rush_get_result. Returns the final result plus {waitedSec, timedOut, pending}. Hard-capped at 540s. For long-running tasks (large top10 sets, ranktracker data accumulation) prefer async: create → rush_get_result later. Module-specific result routing (ranktracker 11 views, ai-results-tracker 4 views) applies here too — use `view` if needed. IMPORTANT: ranktracker view="competitors_positions" requires `competitor` (competitor domain) — API returns 400 without it.

module.description: Rush Analytics module slug. Available: top10, wordstat, suggest, ranktracker, fpp, indexation, adwords, ai-results-tracker. Unavailable slugs (clustering, textanalyzer, whois, …) return "Unknown API function".

view.description: For ranktracker: view name (e.g. "dynamic"). For ai-results-tracker: brand|sources|competitors_brands|competitors_domains.

maxWaitSec.description: Max total wait in seconds (default 120, hard cap 540)

competitor.description: Competitor domain (e.g. "competitor.ru"). REQUIRED for ranktracker view="competitors_positions" — API returns 400 without it. Ignored for all other views.

tools.name: rush_top10
tools.description: Create a Top-10 SERP-parsing task. Optionally wait for the result inline. Yandex by default. Costs balance per keyword. region.device is optional (0=desktop, 1=mobile). Wait hard cap: 540s. For large keyword sets prefer create + rush_get_result later.

wait.description: If true, poll until the result is ready

maxWaitSec.description: Max total wait in seconds (default 180). Hard-capped at 540s to prevent MCP client timeouts. For long-running tasks prefer the async pattern: create first, then rush_get_result later.

tools.name: rush_wordstat
tools.description: Create a Wordstat task (Yandex keyword search volumes). Optionally wait for the result inline. IMPORTANT: at least one of normal/parenthesis/exclamation must be true (default: normal=true). Region is a plain integer `regionid` (e.g. 213 for Moscow) — NOT an object. Wait hard cap: 540s.

regionid.description: Yandex region id as a plain integer (e.g. 213 = Moscow, 51 = Samara)

normal.description: Include broad match frequencies (default true). At least one of normal/parenthesis/exclamation must be true.

maxWaitSec.description: Max total wait in seconds (default 180). Hard-capped at 540s to prevent MCP client timeouts. For long-running tasks prefer the async pattern: create first, then rush_get_result later.

tools.name: rush_suggest
tools.description: Create a search suggestions task (Yandex/Google/YouTube autocomplete). Optionally wait for the result inline. Result is a map: { "<keyword>": ["suggestion1", ...] }. Note: slug is `suggest` (not `suggestions`); result path is /result/suggest/. Wait hard cap: 540s.

yandexRegionId.description: Yandex region id as a plain integer (e.g. 213 = Moscow)

maxWaitSec.description: Max total wait in seconds (default 180). Hard-capped at 540s to prevent MCP client timeouts. For long-running tasks prefer the async pattern: create first, then rush_get_result later.

tools.name: rush_fpp
tools.description: Create a Fast Positions (fpp) task — one-shot rank check for a URL across keywords. POST /create/fpp. Returns {id, type:1}. Use rush_status(type:1, id) or rush_get_result("fpp", id) for results. At least one of yandexRegions/googleRegions must be provided (client-side guard). keywords is a flat array of strings (NOT objects, unlike ranktracker). Wait hard cap: 540s.

url.description: Target URL to check positions for, e.g. "https://example.com"

yandexRegions.description: Yandex regions (at least one of yandexRegions/googleRegions required)

googleRegions.description: Google regions (at least one of yandexRegions/googleRegions required)

keywords.description: Flat array of keyword strings (e.g. ["купить окна", "окна цены"])

wait.description: If true, poll until the result is ready

maxWaitSec.description: Max total wait in seconds (default 180). Hard-capped at 540s to prevent MCP client timeouts. For long-running tasks prefer the async pattern: create first, then rush_get_result later.

tools.name: rush_ranktracker
tools.description: Create a Rank Tracker monitoring project. CREATE-ONLY — no inline wait (this is a recurring project, not a one-off task). WARNING: Rank Tracker is a RECURRING monitoring project. It collects data on a schedule and charges balance each time data is collected. Make sure you intend to set up ongoing monitoring. Returns {id, type:3} immediately. Retrieve results later with rush_get_result using module="ranktracker" and a `view` (e.g. "dynamic", "visibility", "positions_history"). At least one of yandexRegions/googleRegions must be provided. keywords is an array of objects {keyword, targeturl, group?} — not plain strings. hour must be inside dataCollectionFrequency (not top-level). frequency enum: 0=manual/once, 1=daily, 2=every 2 days, 3=every 3 days, 4=weekly.

days.description: Days of week as string, e.g. "1,2,7" (used when frequency=4)

hour.description: Hour of day for collection (0-23). Must be inside this object, not top-level.

yandexRegions.description: Yandex regions to track (at least one of yandexRegions/googleRegions required)

googleRegions.description: Google regions to track (at least one of yandexRegions/googleRegions required)

keywords.description: Keywords to track as objects {keyword, targeturl, group?}

tools.name: rush_projectids
tools.description: Get a list of project ids, optionally filtered by module type. GET /projectids. Free / no balance spent. Read-only. Works without specifying projecttype (returns all projects). Useful for: 'find all my ranktracker projects to force-update or read results'. projecttype values: 1=fpp, 2=top10, 3=ranktracker, 4=wordstat, 5=indexation, 7=suggest, 15=adwords, 32=ai-results-tracker.

projecttype.description: Optional numeric module type filter: 1=fpp, 2=top10, 3=ranktracker, 4=wordstat, 5=indexation, 7=suggest, 15=adwords, 32=ai-results-tracker. Omit to get all projects.

tools.name: rush_update_ranktracker
tools.description: Force-refresh (re-parse) an existing Rank Tracker project by id. POST /update/ranktracker. This is NOT creating or editing a project — it triggers an unscheduled data collection run for an already-existing ranktracker project. ⚠️ WARNING: This operation MAY charge balance — an unscheduled collection is billed at the project's rate. Use with caution and only when you explicitly need fresh data outside the regular schedule. Returns the API response (typically confirmation or error).

projectId.description: Id of the existing ranktracker project to force-refresh

tools.name: rush_gds
tools.description: Get aggregated Looker Studio (Google Data Studio) data for a Rank Tracker project. GET /gds/{view}/{projectid}. Read-only. Only works for ranktracker projects. Returns pre-aggregated summaries — useful for reports without manual pagination of /result/ranktracker/*. Available views (5): positions | visibility | tops | competitors_visibility | schema. NOTE: this view enum is separate from the 11 ranktracker views used in rush_get_result — do not mix them up.

view.description: GDS view: positions | visibility | tops | competitors_visibility | schema. This enum is distinct from the 11 ranktracker views in rush_get_result.
